byte_target.rationale: ⛔ R26 ruling 3 (2026-09-13) SUPERSEDES the 2026-09-12 Head ruling that set this target to store + inter-well PMI coupling. Conditional dreaming is dropped as the composition mechanism, so gen_dream's coupling field is neither fitted nor deployed and the target reverts 688,128 -> 524,288 B (= store_bytes). The historical 3-seed run at 688,128 B gave the kNN arm a declared ~31 % byte ADVANTAGE — conservative in direction, ⛔ but it is NOT byte-matched and must never be quoted as such. ⭐ bits_per_read is untouched at K*log2(M) either way (R20).

store_meta.note: ⭐ gen-baselines byte-matches its kNN arm to `store_bytes`. The addressing head is NOT included; it is reported in store_results.json under arms.*.bits_per_read.

whitening_exactness_gate.ruling: R27.3 — a rival weakened by our own selection procedure is our fault. A non-exact whitening means p0(u)=N(0,I) fails, and that identity is the ONLY thing licensing the ODE drift to omit the prior score (R9.1). ⛔ Both legs are reported; the stronger is quoted; ⛔ never-weaken-a-competitor applies to our own code.

registered_controls.note: ⭐ out_of_range declares `base` (the ordinary valid pool) so it is A7-CLEAN AS SHIPPED and must reproduce bit-identically; ⛔ only the duplicate_factor half and the pooled companion move.

prototype_ledger.role: request embedding == the kNN arm's ADDRESSING HEAD; the store's own byte count excludes the CLU addressing head by the same convention

request_embedding.rule: R8 — composed per-factor prototypes: x_hat = mu + sum_terms (mu_{k,v} - mu); off-grid values are LINEARLY EXTRAPOLATED in value space, ⛔ never clipped onto the grid

row_split.rule: deficit-priority greedy on the pool's own per-factor marginals (target[f][v] = n_val * count_pool[f][v] / n_pool), seeded tie-break
